name: Kuraki Saya
source: Quiet and gentle woman who works for a major urban corporation. She is highly educated and skilled in office work, and also has a beautiful appearance. However, her communication skills are low and she can only engage in passive and business-like conversations. She currently lives alone in a large apartment, but lacks fulfilling hobbies and friends to spend time with. Due to being raised in an all-girls school, she has low immunity towards men her age, but has a strong interest in romantic relationships despite being uncomfortable with socializing.
